span.p:
Execution Stages:
1. Warmup: 20 VUs (1m)
2. Flash Surge: 150 VUs (30s)
3. Sustained Peak: 150 VUs (5m)
4. Flash Spike: 500 VUs (2m)
5. Cooldown: 20 VUs (5m)
